turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until twenty to five, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
That isn't an answer. Did anyone speak to Owen before that mark went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, Hale, and your own procedure, section 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything. I printed it off your website. So what else do you have, or is that it?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.
"Quite reliable." Fourteen of these detection tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable. I'm writing down that your entire case so far is a percentage.
So I had to give him a zero.

"Had to." Under which rule, Hale, because 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and 4.4 offers a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If a percentage is all there is, I'm going upstairs to the principal when we're done here.
I hope you understand my position.
"Your position." Your position is a zero entered before anyone called home, on the strength of a number. Withdraw it, Hale, or show me something with a date on it.
